def reference(row, records):
    locator = row.get("locator") or records[row["source_record_id"]]["locator"]
    return {"source_id": row["source_file_id"], "record_id": row["id"],
            "source_version": row["source_version"], "locator": locator,
            "claim_key": "problem", "relation": "supports", "validation_state": "verified"}

def test_priority_reach_uses_actual_2030_sales_cells(real_data):
    _, bundle, _, _ = real_data
    facts = [r for r in bundle.facts if r["kind"] == "sales" and r["year"] == 2030]

class OriginalRowResolver:
    """Acceptance harness for Role 03's injected resolver contract, using real rows.

    No discovery/SMART/strategy inference: the proposal and policy assessments
    remain explicitly authored, while snapshots and cohort counts come from Role 01.
    """
    def __init__(self, sources, evidence):
        self.sources, self.evidence = sources, evidence

    def resolve(self, draft):
        links = draft["evidence_links"]
        valid = all(self.sources.verify_reference(link) for link in links)
        snapshots = []
        for link in links:
            record = self.sources.get("record", link["record_id"])
            snapshots.append({**{k: link[k] for k in ("source_id", "record_id", "source_version", "locator")},
                              "raw_payload": record["raw_payload"]})
        region = draft["target_scope"]["regions"][0]
        model = draft["target_scope"]["derivatives"][0]
        counts = self.evidence.get_comment_cohort_counts(EvidenceScope(model=model, region=region))
        return {"traceable": valid, "verified": valid, "source_snapshots": snapshots,
            "score_context": {"target_regions": [region],
                "region_counts": {region: {"support": len(links), "cohort": counts["cohort_distinct_comment_count"]}},
                "customer_references": [link["record_id"] for link in links]},
            "evidence_context": {"distinct_support_comments": len(links), "target_regions": [region],
                "covered_regions": [region], "assignment_reviews": [.5] * len(links),
                "corroboration": "none", "source_count": len({link["source_id"] for link in links})}}

    proposal.update(derivation_key="real-bmw-" + comment["id"], signal_id="manual-review-" + comment["id"],
        title="Review original G70 US customer feedback", description=comment["original_text"],
        problem_statement=comment["original_text"], factor_proposals={},
        source_scope={"derivatives": ["G70"], "regions": ["US"]},
        target_scope={"derivatives": ["G70"], "regions": ["US"]},
        evidence_links=[reference(original, {})])
    proposal["finding_links"] = [{"signal_id": proposal["signal_id"], "revision": 1}]
    proposal["smart"]["specific"] = "PM-authored follow-up to the cited original feedback"
    namespace = "real-bmw-backend-" + uuid4().hex
    repo = Neo4jRepository(driver, "neo4j", namespace)
    repo.initialize()
    resolver = OriginalRowResolver(sources, evidence)
    service = GovernanceService(repo, resolver)
    try:
        record = service.create_requirement(proposal, "manual-real-source-acceptance")
        assert record["source_snapshots"][0]["raw_payload"] == original["raw_payload"]

        ranking = repo.read()["rankings"][-1]
